items.item: K3, the in-time sentence's short form (English screen)
items.how: '[Read in time](…#condition-in-time), it cannot hold over every step, since nothing reaches back; read from some step on, it holds exactly where, from any formation at any step, every formation is reached at some later step, through exchanges and each one's going on.' It replaces 'it holds only from some step on, and there exactly where each one's acts, from every step, come to bear on every other's later continuation'. 'Over what comes after' is not joined to it. How-far's 'read in time, from some step on, it holds exactly where the flow is mutually dependent in time' is kept, since it names the from-some-step-on reading as the short form does.
'[按时间来读](…)，它不能在每一步都成立，因为没有什么能到达过去；若从某一步起来读，它恰在这样的地方成立：从任一步的任一形成出发，经由交换与各自的延续，每一个形成都会在此后某一步被到达。' This is the sentence K3 gives, and it matches GLOSSARY.zh. 续无外于后 is not joined to it.

items.item: K7 in How far (both languages, and README's conditional block)
items.how: English: 'under 07 §4.9's hypotheses of activity, support and descent, the course of a line that persists without end [never fits such a list](…), so there this route is silent'. Chinese: '在 07 §4.9 所述的活动、支撑与世系假设之下，一条没有尽头地延续下去的世系，它实际所走的进程从来[列不进这样的列表](…)', in the words USES.zh and GLOSSARY.zh use. The same hypotheses were added to navigation.py's README conditional block, which renders only when readme_conditional_results is non-empty, and it is empty now. That block also says 'where the condition, read across all steps, holds de se' (critic 5.3 item 21) and gives self-concern's reach as 'within its reach', as the anchor says it.

items.item: K10, the Chinese terms on README-ZH
items.how: 每一个延续都能 (was 都可以); 这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切 (was 自身的延续，这里读作自身所能到达的范围之内者); 在能判定容纳与否时 (was 在容纳已判定时); （其逆未证） (was （只证明了这一个方向）, which collided with 依存若只沿一个方向); and 模型所显示的持续存在，只限定了哪些选择可能已经发生，并不表明作选择者持有或形成了某种次序 (was 只是对已作选择的一道筛选，而不是一种已形成的次序). These already matched the glossary: 这一论证路线 beside 两条水平路径, 这一次序就, 世系. The Chinese cover's Philosophy row also takes 这里把自身的延续读作自身所能到达的一切. The retired forms now survive only in the templates' dated comments, checked with the comments stripped. The joint-selection term was made one: 联合选择, as above.

items.item: K1's 'name the relation at every close', on the review cover
items.how: The cover's Philosophy row now asks 'whether, where relations close along being affected, read across all steps, a self-concerned order …' (Chinese: 在关系沿“受影响”闭合之处（跨越所有步来读）), as 07's thesis reads it. The two screens already named the relation ('so that every continuation can be affected, at some remove, by every other'; 即每一个延续都能隔着若干环节受到其他每一个延续影响). No quote of the row exists outside dated reports.

for_ren: The aim is now stated as AGENTS.md states it, on the first screen (both languages), the review cover, RESEARCH.md's lead, MAP and USES: 'a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not come to select for control over its own selection' (这样的联合选择读取自身份额之外的东西，也不会转而去选择对自身之选择的控制). From the fourth pass to the eighth these pages gave AJ's condition 1 instead ('where shaping its rule is selected, the rule still reads what lies beyond the shapers' share, so that a loss there can turn it'), because on 29 October AJ5 found that 'does not select for control' forbids accountable revision whose capacity is rewarded. astra's eighth cold reading agrees with that objection and proposed 'a joint selection that reads beyond its own share and does not reward capture of its selection rule; where the capacity to revise the rule is rewarded, losses beyond the revisers' share can still change it in time'. Which aim wording is right is yours.

The first screen's in-time sentence, both languages: 'Read in time, it cannot hold over every step, since nothing reaches back; read from some step on, it holds exactly where, from any formation at any step, every formation is reached at some later step, through exchanges and each one's going on.'
The site's Chinese navigation line now also offers the register, the open questions and the map of the repository, each marked as English.
